flags.message: context.json freezes distribution_count=2, but one of the two counted distributions is the 2026-05-26 distribution of the sealing motion (25M86), not of the petition; the petition's only distribution is for the 2026-09-28 long conference, which postdates the snapshot. The petition has therefore never been relisted, and the elevated sal-v3 band may partly rest on the motion distribution. I anchored on the frozen band as instructed and adjusted downward in reasoning.md.
